definition: The web console, the JSON API, the event stream, the Origin and Host guard and the MCP endpoint are served by a native router over the native HTTP server: path routing with 404 and 405 and Allow, percent-decoded path and query parameters, JSON bodies and statuses, server-sent events and the loopback guard. Verified by the router unit tests of apps/server and by the end-to-end protocol suite that replaced the Node conformance smoke. axum and its Tower and Hyper stack are gone from Cargo.lock.
